name: Name
noMatchingPatterns: No figures match the current filters.

shareCodeNotFound: No shared list found for this code.
sharingNotAvailable: Cloud sharing is not configured. Add Firebase credentials to app.json.
subscribeErrorOwnList: You own this list — it is already in your library.
subscribeErrorAlreadySubscribed: You are already subscribed to this list.

unpublishConfirmMessage: This will remove the list from the cloud. Others will no longer be able to subscribe to it.
unpublishSuccessMessage: The list is no longer shared.
publishHint: Anyone with the code can follow the list.
deletePatternConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete '{{name}}'?
videoUrlInvalid: URL must start with http:// or https://
deleteModifierConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this modifier?
notAppliedToAnyPattern: Not applied to any figure yet
prerequisiteWouldCycle: Greyed-out figures would create a prerequisite loop.
prerequisiteCycleWarning: {{count}} figures are in a prerequisite loop, so their order cannot be shown.
resetLayoutConfirm: Put every figure back where the app placed it? Your arrangement will be lost.

trimWindowA11y: Part of the video to process
anonymizeTapDancers: Tap each dancer on this frame ({{count}}/{{total}})
anonymizeTooLong: Anonymizing works on up to {{max}} s — make the selection shorter.
videoEditNowMessage: Cut it down to the part you need, and anonymize the dancers if you like (up to 30 s). It runs in the background, and you check the result before it replaces the video in this figure.
cameraPermissionDeniedHint: Allow camera access in your phone's settings to record a video for a figure.
cannotRemoveOnlyType: The only type: add another to move its figures to, then remove this one
transcribeNoSound: An anonymized video has no sound to transcribe.
transcriptEmpty: No speech was found in this video.
transcriptLineRemoveHint: Leave empty to remove the line
transcribeErrorDownload: the speech model could not be downloaded; check the connection and try again
speechModelHint: Transcribes what is said in videos. Downloaded with the first transcription.
speechModelAccurateHint: Better with accents and dance terms, but slower. Once downloaded, transcription uses it instead of the speech model.
includeTranscriptsHint: What teachers said in the videos goes with them. Leave off unless the recipients should read it.
includeTranscriptsNeedsVideos: Transcripts travel with their videos: include videos first.
suggestRun: Suggest name and description with AI
suggestDownloadHint: Suggestions are written on this phone by a small AI language model, a one-time download of {{size}} MB. Wi-Fi recommended.
suggestWaiting: Waiting for the video work to finish …
suggestThinking: The AI is writing a suggestion … usually under a minute.
suggestFailed: No suggestion this time. Try again.
suggestNothing: Nothing to suggest: this video does not seem to teach a figure.
suggestApplyHint: Fills the name only if it is empty; the description gets a paragraph of its own. Check it against the video.
transcriptCopyHint: Tick lines to copy them word for word into the description.
suggestExplain: An AI model on this phone reads the whole transcript and writes a name and a short description in its own words. Nothing changes until you choose to use it.
suggestLeaveHint: You can close the transcript and keep working. The suggestion then waits below the figure's videos for you to review. Keep DPM open until it is done.
suggestJobQueued: {{name}}: waiting to suggest a name and description
suggestJobWriting: {{name}}: the AI is writing a suggestion …
suggestJobInFormQueued: Waiting to suggest a name and description
suggestJobInFormWriting: The AI is writing a suggestion …
suggestErrorDownload: the AI model could not be downloaded; check the connection and try again
suggestErrorAnswer: the AI gave no usable answer; try again
suggestionModelHint: Drafts a figure name and description from a transcript.
videoReviewHint: Nothing in the figure changes until you choose. The original video stays on your phone either way.
videoReviewAddTranscript: Add the whole transcript to the description
videoReviewNoRoom: There are already {{max}} videos here, so there is no room to keep both.
videoJobReview: {{name}}: the new video is ready to check
videoJobInFormReview: A new video is ready to check
videoEditOnlyLocal: Only videos saved on the phone can be edited, and there are already {{max}} videos here. Remove one to pick a video from the gallery.
videoEditOnlineHint: Online videos can't be edited, only videos saved on the phone.
anonymizeWhy: Hides who the dancers are, so everyone in the clip can be comfortable with it being shared: as silhouettes, or with only their faces covered. The sound is removed.
videoShortenHint: Drag either end of the bar to choose the part to keep.
videosFullHint: Holds up to {{max}} videos. Remove one to add another.
suggestJobReview: {{name}}: a name and description are suggested
suggestJobInFormReview: A name and description are suggested
suggestReviewTranscriptKept: The transcript stays on the video either way.
transcribeThenSuggest: Then suggest a name and description
videoJobsKeepOpen: These run on the phone. You can switch to another app and get a notification when they finish, but don't close DPM.
anonymizeTapFrameHint: Can't see every dancer on this frame? Go back and start the selection where they are.
modelDownloadFailed: Download failed. Check the connection and try again.
videoJobsNotifyReview: Open DPM to review the results.
videoJobsNotifyFailed: Something went wrong. Open DPM to see what.
videoJobsNotifyDone: Everything is saved to your figures.
loadPatternListsFailed: Could not load the figure lists: {{error}}
importErrorNotAnExport: The file is not a figure list export.
importErrorTooNew: This file was made by a newer version of the app. Update to import it.
importErrorTooOld: This file was made by a version of the app that is no longer supported.
importErrorNoLists: The file contains no figure lists.
importErrorDuplicateListId: Two lists in the file share the id {{id}}.
importErrorPatternsNotList: Its figures were not a list.
importErrorPatternNoId: A figure has no usable id.
importWarnVideosNotList: Its videos were not a list and have been dropped.
importWarnMalformedProvenance: Dropped malformed provenance of a video.
importWarnMalformedTranscript: Dropped a malformed transcript of a video.
importWarnTypeNoId: Dropped a figure type with no id.
importWarnModifiersNotList: Its modifiers were not a list.
importWarnModifierNoId: Dropped a modifier with no id.
importWarnModifierRefsNotList: Its modifier attachments were not a list.
importWarnModifierRefNoId: Dropped a modifier attachment with no id.
importWarnModifierRefUnknown: Dropped an attachment to a modifier that is not in the list.
importWarnUnknownType: Its figure type is not in the list.
importWarnPrerequisiteNotNumber: Dropped a prerequisite that was not a number.
importWarnPrerequisiteNotInFile: It referenced a prerequisite that is not in the file.
importWarnVideoDataUnreadable: The embedded video data was not readable and was ignored.
importWarnVideoRestoreFailed: A video could not be restored.
importWarnVideoDataMissing: The data for a video is missing.
styleAfterHoursHint: Warm and roomy. Made for practising and socials.
styleClipboardHint: Dense and structured. Made for running a course.
compactListDescription: Each figure on one line, its type a coloured dot, with less space between rows.
levelClearHint: Tap the selected level again to leave it unset.
appIconColorHint: The colour of the icon on your home screen. Changing it closes the app.
reelsEmptyList: No videos in this list yet. Open a figure, add a video under Videos, and it shows up here.
reelsEmptyAll: No videos in any list yet.
importWarnRhythmMismatch: Its rhythm did not match its counts and was left out.
rhythmInvalid: Not a rhythm yet. Count every beat from 1: 3&4 is a triple, (4) a tap or pause. It is saved once it is one.
danceHint: Suggests the dance's basic rhythms and helps transcription recognise its terms.
videoShortenWhat: Keeps only the part you choose. The sound stays.
anonymizeProviderTrackingNote: Each dancer becomes a coloured silhouette. Nothing of the footage is kept.
anonymizeProviderFacesNote: The dancers stay as filmed with their faces covered, and the room is blurred. Check the result: a face can slip through when a dancer turns fast or is hidden.
anonymizeExperimentalNote: Anonymizing is still experimental: on older phones it can take many minutes, and tracking can lose a dancer. Preview the first half second before the full render.
anonymizePreviewReady: The first half second, slowed down. If the dancers are followed, anonymize the whole part; if not, tap the dancers again.
anonymizePreviewFailed: The preview could not be rendered. You can still anonymize the whole part, or tap the dancers again.
anonymizeOutlineCheck: The highlighted outline is who will be followed. Wrong person? Tap again.
anonymizeOutlineMissed: Nobody was found where you tapped dancer {{number}}. Tap again, on the middle of their body.
anonymizeOutlineFailed: The outline could not be shown. You can still anonymize, or tap the dancers again.
videoTranscribeFirstShorten: Writes down what is said in the whole video before the cut.
videoTranscribeFirstAnonymize: The anonymized video has no sound, so this is the last chance to transcribe it.
transcribeWhat: Writes down what is said in the whole video, so you can read it and add lines to the description.
transcribeThenSuggestWhat: From what was said. You review the suggestion before anything changes.
whatsNewTurnOffHint: You can turn this off in Settings.
whatsNewHintSetting: Show what's new after an update
whatsNewHintSettingDescription: A short note on what changed, the first time you open a new version.
noPatternsHint: Tap + to add one. A figure can name the figures it builds on and keep your own videos of it.
exampleDescSugarPush: The follower walks in, compresses into the leader's frame and is sent back down the slot.
exampleDescLeftSidePass: The leader steps out of the slot and the follower passes on the leader's left side.
exampleDescUnderarmTurn: The follower passes on the leader's right side, turning under the raised arm.
exampleDescSugarTuck: A sugar push whose tuck sends the follower into a turn.
exampleDescBasicWhip: Eight counts: the leader rotates the follower around and sends them back down the slot.
exampleDescTuckTurn: A left side pass with a tuck that sends the follower into a turn.
exampleDescBasketWhip: A two-handed whip: the follower is wrapped into the basket and unwrapped again.
exampleDescBehindTheBackWhip: A whip with a hand change behind the leader's back.
videoOnlineIntro: Upload it to YouTube or Vimeo, then bring its link back here. As a link it can go into a list you publish. Choose Unlisted on YouTube, or Unlisted or a password on Vimeo, so only people with the link can watch it. YouTube and Vimeo links play inside DPM; Google Drive links don't.
videoOnlineShared: If the upload hasn't started, share again. Otherwise wait until it's done in that app, then bring the link back.
videoOnlineLinkHint: When the upload is done, tap Share in that app and choose DPM. Or copy the link and paste it here.
videoOnlineHowYouTube: YouTube: under You → Your videos, tap ⋮ next to the video, then Share, and choose DPM.
videoOnlineHowVimeo: Vimeo: set the video's privacy to Unlisted or give it a password, then copy its link.
videoOnlineHowDrive: Google Drive: tap ⋮ next to the file, then Share → Manage access, set it to Anyone with the link, and copy the link.
videoOnlineNoCopiedLink: What you copied holds no link.
videoLinkWontPlay: This link won't play in DPM, which plays YouTube and Vimeo videos and direct links to a video file. Use it anyway?
videoOnlineReplaceNote: The link takes this video's place in the figure and keeps its transcript. The file stays on your phone.
videoOnlineBusy: Wait until the work on this video has finished.
videoOnlineShareFailed: The share menu could not be opened.
videoOnlineLinkFailed: The link could not be saved. Try again.
shareInLinkMessage: Use it in place of the video of "{{name}}" you shared? It keeps that video's transcript.
shareInLinkMessageWontPlay: Use it in place of the video of "{{name}}" you shared? It keeps that video's transcript. This link won't play in DPM, which plays YouTube and Vimeo videos and direct links to a video file.
shareInAddVideo: Add the video to a figure in "{{list}}".
shareInExistingPattern: Or add it to a figure
shareInFailed: The video could not be added. Try again.
shareInNoList: Open one of your own lists first, then share it again.
shareInNothing: DPM can take a video, or a link to one. What was shared had neither.
suggestIntro: Your suggestion goes to the owner of {{list}}, who decides whether to add it.
suggestVideosHint: Only video links are sent. Videos saved on your phone stay on your phone.
suggestSendFailed: Your suggestion could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
suggestMuted: The list owner is not taking suggestions from you.
suggestLimitReached: This list has taken all the suggestions it takes today. Try again tomorrow.
suggestClosed: This list is not taking suggestions right now.
suggestUnavailable: Suggestions cannot be sent right now. Check your connection and try again.
suggestSentMessage: The list owner decides whether to add it. If they do, it appears in your copy of the list.
suggestionsOffHint: Subscribers cannot suggest figures right now. You can let them in Lists → Manage Cloud Sharing.
suggestionMuteMessage: They can no longer send suggestions to this list. What they already sent stays here for you to review, and you can unmute them below the suggestions.
suggestionActionFailed: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.
allowEditSuggestionsHint: A video, a tag or a fix to the counts, for example. You choose what to apply.
suggestEditIntro: The owner of {{list}} reviews your change and decides what to apply. Your copy stays as it is until then.
suggestEditNothing: Nothing has changed yet. Change something to suggest it.
suggestEditSentMessage: The list owner decides what to apply. Anything they apply appears in your copy of the list.
suggestionEditGone: This figure is no longer in the list.
suggestionEditDone: The figure already has these changes.
suggestionEditReviewHint: Untick what you don't want. A change you have since made differently yourself starts unticked.
suggestionEditAnonymized: Marked as anonymized by the sender. Watch it to check.
suggestionEditUploadedBySender: Uploaded by the sender. It stays on their account.
allowSuggestionsHint: They arrive in the List tab.
listNoAccessMessage: "{{name}}" is now only for members the list owner has let in. Your copy has been kept and is now fully editable. To get updates again, look up the list's code and ask to join.
membersButtonLabel: Members and requests to join ({{count}} waiting)
membersHint: Only the people you let in can open this list. Anyone who looks up its code can ask to join.
membersEmpty: Nobody has asked to join yet.
memberRemoveMessage: Their copy stops updating, and they can't ask to join again unless you let them in. Video links they've already seen keep working.
membersActionFailed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
membersOnlyHint: Others with the code can ask to join.
membersOnlyConfirmMessage: Everyone subscribed so far loses access until they ask to join and you let them in.
membersOnlyListTitle: This list is for members only
membersOnlyAskHint: Ask the list owner to let you in. They'll see the name you give here. Asking signs this phone in anonymously, without an account.
membersAsked: You've asked to join. Once the list owner lets you in, look the code up again.
membersDeclinedYou: The list owner hasn't let you in to this list.
membersAskFailed: Your request could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
handOverHint: Give this list to someone who follows it, such as the teacher taking over your class. They become its owner, the share code stays the same, and everyone subscribed keeps following it.
handOverConfirmMessage: You get a code to pass on. Once the new owner enters it, they edit and publish the list, and your copy follows theirs, read-only. Videos stored only on this phone and transcripts are not handed over.
handOverCodeHint: The new owner subscribes to this list, then on the Lists screen taps ⋮ next to it and chooses Take over this list. The code works once, for {{days}} days.
handOverFailed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
takeOverHint: Enter the handover code the list's owner gave you. You become its owner: you can edit it, and everyone subscribed follows your changes.
takeOverInvalidCode: A handover code has 10 letters and digits.
takeOverRefused: This code doesn't work. It may be mistyped, already used, withdrawn, or older than {{days}} days.
takeOverFailed: The list could not be taken over. Check your connection and try again.
takeOverSuccessMessage: You now own "{{name}}". Your edits reach everyone subscribed to it.
listHandedOverMessage: "{{name}}" now belongs to the person you handed it to. Your copy follows theirs and is read-only here.
scanHandoverCodeHint: Point the camera at the handover QR code
unsubscribeListConfirm: Remove '{{name}}' from this phone? You can subscribe again with its share code.
subscribedListHint: You follow this list. Only the list owner can change it.
rhythmSuggestionHint: Uses this rhythm and sets the counts to match.
laneHandleHint: Hold, then drag up or down to change the order of the lanes
resetLaneOrderConfirm: Go back to the automatic lane order? The app then arranges the lanes to keep linked figures close together. Your order will be lost.
legendTapToRecolor: Tap a type to change its colour.
variantHint: A variant is this figure danced with a modifier. Pick one to see its videos.
modifierDescriptionPlaceholder: What it changes, in a sentence
modifierDescInsideTurn: The follower turns towards the leader, under the joined hands.
modifierDescOutsideTurn: The follower turns away from the leader, under the joined hands.
modifierDescFreeSpin: The follower spins with no hand held, and the leader reconnects after.
modifierDescDuck: The leader ducks under the joined hands after the follower's inside turn.
modifierDescHesitation: The leader holds the movement for a beat or more before going on.
modifierDescHandChange: The leader passes the follower's hand from one of their hands to the other.
editTypes: Edit the list and its types
termsMessage: Before you share anything, please agree to DPM's terms of use. In short: share only what you have the right to share, and don't show anyone in a video without their consent (a parent's, for a child). Illegal content is removed.
reportListHint: Tell us if this list breaks the law or the terms of use. We look at every report. The list owner is not told who reported it.
reportDetailsPlaceholder: Which figure or video, and what's wrong with it
reportContactPlaceholder: Only if you'd like a reply
reportGoodFaith: By sending, you confirm the report is accurate to the best of your knowledge.
reportSentMessage: Thank you. We'll look at it and remove the list if it breaks the law or the terms of use.
reportFailed: The report could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
